avis.titre: I absolutely love this moisturizer although…
avis.texte: For how expensive this product is, you would expect the packaging to be much better but it's not. The container is made of cheap plastic, and the gold top piece that holds the applicator actually broke off, which was really frustrating. That said, I genuinely love the moisturizer itself. It makes my skin feel amazing, it doesn't burn or irritate my skin, and it leaves my complexion looking great. I even get compliments on my skin when I use it. It also works well under makeup and blends nicely with other products. My biggest issues are the price and the packaging. For something this expensive, the packaging should feel far more luxurious. At the very least, it should be made of glass or designed to be refillable so you could reuse the container and just purchase inserts. That would add a lot more value. Unfortunately, the current packaging just feels very low quality for the price.

Complimentary from tatcha Tatcha Dewy Moisture Cream – My Thoughts Tatcha just launched their Dewy Moisture Cream, and after trying it, I can say it lives up to the name. It's a rich, deeply hydrating formula made for dry or mature skin. The ingredients are impressive—hyaluronic acid, red algae, squalane, Japanese purple rice, and their signature Hadasei‑3 complex—all focused on locking in moisture and strengthening the skin barrier. The texture is creamy and smooth, and it melts into the skin beautifully. It leaves a soft, dewy finish that makes the skin look fresh and well-nourished. If you have oily or acne-prone skin, this might feel a bit heavy—so a patch test is a good idea before fully using it. Overall, it's a luxurious cream for anyone needing intense hydration, especially during colder months or when the skin feels dull and tight. A great addition to any nighttime routine.

So I have been a loyal DE Protini purchaser for awhile now and always felt satisfied with that specific product UNTIL I decided to give this girl a try and oh...my... goodness! It is indescribably luxurious and long lasting! If DE Protini and Bora Barrier had a baby, THIS would be her!!!! So I have loved DE Protini for my morning routine and DE Bora Barrier for night routine because it is MUCH thicker (almost TOO thick). But I would normally feel like my skin was moisturized when I woke up in the morning, but some mornings not so much. But this Tatcha Dewy Skin is perfection in a container- a little goes a long way, especially after the first few steps in my routine, and the moisturizing effect lasts until I wash my face again, but doesn't feel heavy and wet if you know what I mean? Some moisturizers are great, but they do not seem to absorb as intended, and like a layer of damp on my face ready to grab any wisps of hair near my face. This product TRULY absorbs, and continuously works as a true moisturizing mask until washed off. LOVE it! Sorry DE, but definitely retiring my Bora Barrier permanently.
